description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Class' that extends behavior for handling 'class' attributes in HTML. It provides methods to split class attribute strings and filter class tokens according to configuration rules.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_HTML_Class
classes.description: Handles special behavior for the HTML 'class' attribute, specifically for NMTOKENS type, with methods to split attribute strings and filter class tokens based on configuration.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a class attribute string into tokens, with special handling for XHTML 1.1 and 2.0 doctype where a parent method is used; otherwise splits on whitespace.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a list of class tokens based on allowed and forbidden classes specified in the configuration.
